5521 chole {khol-ay'}

源自可能近似與 5514 相同意思的字 (源自綠色色彩); 陰性名詞

record.edic_text:
5521 chole {khol-ay'}

from an equivalent perhaps akin to the same as 5514 (from the greenish
   hue);; n f

AV - gall 2; 2

2) in the OT used of other bitter things
   2a) wormwood
   2b) possibly myrrh
